== Spoken name ==
The printed name is '''Lynden Pater''' ([[Players Committee]] organization chart, 6 May 2024: Proofing Team / ideatrack; [[Holotheatre]] S3E25 overlay "Special Guest Lynden Pater"). Spoken introductions on the cited videos use other spellings:

* [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HHfY5LzO9lc JNap Retro League, ideatrack's Games 5 & 6] (27 March 2022), about 1:56: "Lyndon Peter", "Idea Tracker", "a UK player".
* [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfDGImArERY Holotheatre S3E25 Play All The Things!] (23 June 2022), about 3:54: "Lyndon Patter", then "Idea Track". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015193624/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfDGImArERY Internet Archive].

Further heard variants from those same videos: Lyndon Pader. Canonical title stays [[Lynden Pater]]; [[Ideatrack]] redirects here.
